description: Zone rizika od poplava (HQ10, HQ100, HQ500) u Crnoj Gori – prostorni podaci (2025) is a dataset listed in DATA.GOV.ME, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministarstvo poljoprivrede, šumarstva i vodoprivrede. Ovaj skup podataka sadrži prostorne podatke (poligone) zona rizika od poplava u Crnoj Gori za scenarije HQ10, HQ100 i HQ500. Podaci su objedinjeni u jedinstven GeoJSON fajl i uključuju atribut „scenario“ koji označava povratni period poplava. Coverage: Ministarstvo poljoprivrede, šumarstva i vodoprivrede. The publisher named on the listing is Ministarstvo poljoprivrede, šumarstva i vodoprivrede. Its keywords include risk, rizik, flood, spatial data, hazard, GIS. The listing shows 3 download or service links in DCAT-AP, GEOJSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-me.
